reviewed_change_effects.effect: Existing pickup material coloured emission gains32x; the single bounded light becomes explicitly32lumens and moves from emblem+10cm to-48cm while its64cm attenuation radius stays unchanged. S3 additionally reflects each part position from(X,Y,Z) to(X,-Y,Z) and local yaw to-Yaw, keeping positive scales, so the authored skull/numeral orientation matches the ordinary overhead camera. Material opacity/warning behaviour, actor ownership, overlap, damage and reward authority are unchanged. Actual corrected visual/performance verification remains S3-specific.

Stage7 finds an unowned family using IsFamilyRollEligible rather than only the equipped family; stage8 additionally requires a valid acquisition plan at the same inventory revision. No firing/reload/inventory production file changes.
